common.name: Name
home.headline: Same-day Association fishing passes under authorised pillars.
home.sub: Pay RM5 Association fee, pick a boarding jetty and pillar, show your QR at check-in. Boat fare stays with your skipper.
auth.signupSub: Malaysian citizens aged {min}+ only. Under-{min} registration is blocked (SRS). MyDigitalID optional later.
auth.signupHero: Register as a Malaysian angler ({min}+) to buy a same-day Association fishing pass under authorised bridge pillars. Age is checked from MyKad (or DOB).
auth.name: Full name
auth.underAgeBody: Anglers must be at least {min} years old (SRS). Based on {source}, age is {age}. Registration cannot continue.
auth.ageNeed: Enter a valid 12-digit MyKad or DOB so we can verify you are {min}+.
auth.photoHint: Align your face in the oval and snap. File upload is not allowed.
auth.acceptPdpa: I consent to PDPA processing of my identity data ({notice}).
auth.acceptLocation: I consent to location capture to verify I am at the jetty when buying a pass and during boarding.
auth.blockedAge: Anglers must be at least {min} years old. Detected age: {age}.
auth.photoRequired: Identity photo is required. Take a live photo with your camera.
auth.ageUnknown: Could not determine age. Enter a valid 12-digit MyKad or date of birth.
pass.title: Same-day fishing pass
pass.subtitle: At the jetty → one pillar → RM5 Association fee. Arrange a boat outside the app.
pass.qrHint: Show this QR at the jetty for check-in / check-out. Valid for check-in on {date}. Checked-in stayovers can check out the next day.
pass.qrAfterPay: QR is available after successful payment while the pass is Active or Checked-In.
pass.boatHint: Arrange outside the app with a registered operator
pass.pay.title: Pay Association fee
pass.pay.stripeHint: You will be redirected to Stripe Checkout. Your pass activates after payment is confirmed.
pass.pay.hitpayHint: You will be redirected to HitPay to pay with GrabPay, ShopeePay, or Atome (sandbox). Your pass activates after payment is confirmed.
pass.pay.checkoutMissingUrl: Checkout did not return a payment link. Try again.
pass.pay.hitpayMissingUrl: HitPay did not return a checkout link. Try again.
pass.pay.keysMissing: Payment keys missing — using mock. Set Stripe or HitPay keys and restart, or keep using Demo / fallback below.
pass.pay.mockHint: Mock payment only. Admin Ops can select Stripe or HitPay when keys are configured.
pass.pay.failedRetry: Payment failed. Slot released — try again.
pass.paid.title: Payment return
pass.paid.confirmingBody: Waiting for payment confirmation. This page refreshes automatically. Keep this tab open for a moment.
pass.paid.expiredBody: The hold timed out before payment completed. Buy a pass again.
pass.paid.failedBody: Payment failed or was cancelled. You can try again from Buy a pass.
pass.notFoundHint: This pass is missing or belongs to another account. Open My Passes to view tickets on this login.
pass.offlineStale: Offline copy — status may be stale. Last synced {when}.
pass.offlineMissing: No offline copy of this pass. Open it once while online to cache the QR.
pass.overnight.title: Overnight stay
pass.overnight.hint: Optional intention only — your pass stays same-day. Tell us if you may stay under the pillar overnight.
pass.selfCheckout.title: Self check-out at jetty
pass.selfCheckout.hint: When you are back on shore at this boarding jetty, declare and check out. GPS must show you are at the jetty.
pass.selfCheckout.remindBody: Your stay is past the expected return or overdue window. Charge your phone if needed, return to the jetty, then check out here — or ask an operator to scan your QR.
pass.selfCheckout.declaration: I am already on shore at the boarding jetty and accept responsibility if this declaration is false.
pass.selfCheckout.needDeclaration: Tick the shore declaration before checking out.
pass.selfCheckout.gpsDenied: Location permission is required. Enable GPS at the jetty, then try again.
pass.selfCheckout.gpsError: Could not read your location. Enable GPS at the jetty and try again.
pass.selfCheckout.operatorFallback: No signal or GPS issues? Show your QR to an operator for check-out.
pass.wizard.overnightHint: Does not extend the pass fee or validity. Helps ops know your expected return.
pass.changePillarBody: This cancels your current pass ({pillar}) so you can buy another pillar. You must pay the Association fee again.
pass.cancelPassBody: This cancels your pass and frees the pillar slot. You can buy a new same-day pass afterwards.
pass.cancelNoRefund: The Association fee already paid is non-refundable.
pass.changePillarDone: Pass cancelled. Choose a new pillar and pay again.
pass.alreadyHave: You already have a pass for today ({ref}).
pass.changeBeforeBoard: To fish under a different pillar, cancel this pass and buy again (fee non-refundable). Not available after check-in.
trips.title: My passes
trips.subtitle: Same-day Association fishing passes.
scan.title: Scanner
scan.subtitle: Scan, confirm the angler, then the camera stays ready for the next pass.
scan.gpsOff: Testing: jetty GPS check is off in Settings.
scan.gpsRequired: GPS is required on Confirm. You must be at your registered jetty.
scan.cameraHint: Paste a QR token below to check in without the camera, or open the camera to scan.
scan.scanning: Scanning… hold the QR inside the box
scan.cameraReady: Camera on — confirm below, then scan the next pass
scan.name: Name
scan.compareHint: Visually compare the person to the photo before confirming.
scan.offlineCacheHint: Showing cached offline pack (may be stale until sync).
handler.noneInHint: Scan an Active pass to check an angler in.
handler.noPassesYet: No passes for this jetty yet.
handler.noProfileHint: This login is not linked to an operator record. Ask Association Admin to link you under Boat Operators / People.
handler.fleetSub: Boats linked to your operator profile.
handler.linkFirst: Link this user to an operator first.
admin.opsSub: Live boarding, pillars, alerts, and payments.
admin.operatorsSub: Edit display name, jetty, owner, and optional operator licence. Create login accounts under People (role Operator).
admin.alertsSub: Alerts are auto-generated from overdue check-ins, boat permit expiry, and failed payments. Incidents are logged by ops.
admin.syncSub: Review CI/CO events that could not apply cleanly after jetty devices came back online.
admin.noConflicts: No open sync conflicts. Offline scans that cannot apply cleanly appear here.
admin.ops.stillUnderHint: Long stays (incl. overnight) · over {hours}h checked in
admin.people.createDesc: Create anglers, boatmen, or admins. Boatmen need a jetty assignment.
admin.people.opLicenceHint: Skipper/operator ID — not the boat permit (set under Boats).
admin.operators.editDesc: Updates the same handler record shown under People. Account role and password stay in People.
llm.title: Bridge Fishing Monitoring
profile.title: Profile
profile.sub: Identity and contacts for fishing passes and boarding.
offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: TiangPass shell works offline. Operators can board from a downloaded offline pack; anglers can show a cached pass QR. Purchase and Admin still need a network connection.
